{{Quote|There she is&mdash;the Entity. Such pure dark side energy. Is she not utterly beautiful?|Darth Vowrawn to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Baras's Lair" />}}
'''The Entity''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] enslaved by [[Darth Baras]], who helped facilitate his rise to power and ascendancy onto the [[Dark Council]] with her powers of [[Precognition/Legends|precognition]] and [[Farsight/Legends|farseeing]]. Centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]], the Entity nearly conquered the galaxy and almost eradicated the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Darth Vowrawn]] said that she was as old as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and an embodiment of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] itself.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Free! Now. I am. Forgotten again. And grateful. Remember me. To the defiler.|The Entity to Darth Vowrawn and the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Baras's Lair" />}}
Some time before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Darth Baras]] bound and indentured the Entity on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He fed off the spirit's power and stole all her visions of the future, from which he used to build his power base in the Empire. The Entity abhorred being used in this way but could do nothing about it due to the strength of Baras' enchantments.

Somehow, the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Vowrawn]] discovered that the Entity was being enslaved by [[Darth Baras]] and worked for an unknown period of time to free her from his grip. Once he discovered how to free the Sith spirit, an opportunity in which to do so would not come until years later, with the appearance of the second [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], Baras' former apprentice. But Vowrawn was not convinced that the former apprentice was actually trying to help him until he was attacked by Darth Baras' assassin on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during which the Wrath protected him; this relationship eventually led to an [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|assault]] on Baras' on-world base. After finally reaching the chamber of the Entity, they were confronted by a now-cyborg [[Draahg]], who used a death field on Vowrawn to prevent him from freeing the spirit. The Entity then informed the Wrath that Draahg's cybernetics powered the death field, and that his death would cancel it. After a long and vicious duel, the Wrath beheaded Draahg, releasing Vowrawn. But, before freeing the Entity, Vowrawn had her confirm that Baras was viewing all that had transpired through her, guessing that he must have been twisting with fury. After the Entity had been set free, she told the Wrath to remember her to Baras before returning to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
